import asyncio
import os
import re
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", "code", "legalclear", "backend"))
sys.path.insert(0, "/home/joe/code/legalclear/backend")

from dotenv import load_dotenv
load_dotenv("/home/joe/code/legalclear/backend/.env")

from src.agents.explainer import ExplainerAgent
from src.agents.form_guide import FormGuideAgent

URL_RE = re.compile(r"https?://[^\s'\"]+")

async def main():
    explainer = ExplainerAgent()
    explainer_text = (
        "NOTICE TO QUIT. You are hereby notified that your tenancy at "
        "123 Main St, Orlando, FL is terminated for nonpayment of rent. "
        "You have 3 days to pay or vacate the premises."
    )
    explainer_result = await explainer.explain(explainer_text, language="en")
    print("=== EXPLAINER OUTPUT ===")
    print(explainer_result)

    form_guide = FormGuideAgent()
    document = {"text": "I want to file a small claim against my landlord for my security deposit of $1500 which they did not return within 15 days of move-out."}
    classification = {
        "document_type": "small_claims_statement_of_claim",
        "issuing_agency": "Florida Small Claims Court",
        "jurisdiction_name": "Orange County, FL",
        "filing_deadline": None,
    }
    form_guide_result = await form_guide.guide(document, classification, lang="en")
    print("=== FORM GUIDE OUTPUT ===")
    print(form_guide_result)

    combined = str(explainer_result) + str(form_guide_result)
    print("=== GREP RESULTS ===")
    print("floridalawhelp:", "floridalawhelp" in combined.lower())
    print("floridabar:", "floridabar" in combined.lower())
    urls = URL_RE.findall(combined)
    print("bare URLs found:", urls)

asyncio.run(main())
